$comment: Animation library. Definitions are data, not .ffx binaries: .ffx cannot be generated programmatically, bakes fixed keyframes that cannot adapt to caption duration, and is near-impossible to remove cleanly when swapping. Every animation is generated procedurally under the Capset__ prefix, so replacing one is an exact teardown and rebuild. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 3. The token "$textColor" resolves to the layer's own fill colour at apply time, so a colour animation settles on the colour the user chose rather than overwriting it. ease.in and ease.out are After Effects keyframe INFLUENCE percentages, applied to the incoming and outgoing side of every key in the phase. Higher influence means a more gradual change at that side, so an entrance that punches has a high in (decelerate into place) and a low out (leave the start pose immediately); an exit is the mirror.

animations.name: Word Pop
animations.description: Hard scale punch, no fade. The short-form default — reads instantly at speed.

animations.name: Hormozi
animations.description: Punches in from an accent colour and settles into yours, with a rotation kick.

animations.name: Karaoke Fill
animations.description: Colour sweeps word by word across the caption as it is spoken.

animations.name: Impact
animations.description: Slams in oversized and snaps to size through a blur. Heavy hits.

animations.name: Bounce Up
animations.description: Springs up from below and overshoots before settling.

animations.name: Tighten
animations.description: Letters draw together into place. Clean, editorial, not shouty.

animations.name: Typewriter
animations.description: Characters appear one at a time, hard cut, no fade.

animations.name: No Animation
animations.description: Captions cut in and out on their timings. Nothing is applied.
